name: DockFlow
tagline: Save and switch between macOS Dock layouts.
description:
Save a Dock preset for each project or Focus mode. Presets can include apps, folders, files, links, and spacers. Recall them with a keyboard shortcut or an automation. DockFlow requires macOS 13.5 or later. The optional Lock Dock feature needs Accessibility permission.

## Pricing
Lifetime Access includes one year of updates. Forever Edition includes future updates.
pricingDetails: Lifetime and Forever one-time licenses available
